items.text: Among adults examined in the 14 network practices in one month of 2027, what proportion have a recall interval concordant with their recorded risk category, and how does this differ by independent risk markers and area deprivation?
items.population: Adults with a routine examination in the 14 practices in March 2027
items.comparator: Recall interval set at that examination
items.outcome: Concordance of interval with risk under the guideline mapping; missing interval

finer: Feasible in six months of part-time research time; interesting to commissioners; novel locally; ethical as anonymised records under the governance note; relevant to 2028 contracts.
summary: One PECO question on concordance and missing intervals.
